issue.title: Stabilize Models panel effort-picker PNG snapshot drift
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-m9.1.1.2 while landing the shell-taxonomy epic. The Models panel effort-picker visual snapshot has a repeatable local 111-pixel PNG drift unrelated to shell terminology. Keep this distinct from the Artifacts/Beads select_entry_target failure routed to active epic sase-m6 and distinct from the retired broad PNG drift umbrella sase-dl. Scope: reproduce the specific Models effort-picker visual snapshot, inspect the actual/expected/diff artifacts under .pytest_cache/sase-visual, decide whether the UI changed intentionally or the fixture/renderer setup is unstable, and update only the focused code or golden needed for that node.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-dl — retired broad ACE PNG drift umbrella. This new task is intentionally narrower: one Models panel effort-picker snapshot with repeatable 111-pixel local drift, not the broad multi-surface renderer/provider drift tracked and canceled on sase-dl.

AUDIT sase-mi.1 at HEAD de83c802d: commit 28da68d4e redesigned the Models panel and regenerated models_panel_*effort_picker* goldens. just test-visual on test_models_panel_builtin_selection_effort_step_png_snapshot and test_models_panel_alias_selection_effort_step_png_snapshot: 2 passed in 7.18s. The old 111-pixel drift is not present against current goldens. Matrix: file:explicit:f844d28a2e9d3118782bcdfe

payload.close_reason: Models effort-picker goldens regenerated; focused PNG snapshots pass
